uzo.purpose: Chooses one of many options from a list that opens on demand: country, language, year.

instead.kialo: Up to five options read faster when they all stay visible, because a list hides them behind a click; Fundamento covers it with elekto.

A combobox with a search in its list is the kompletigilo, because a person who knows a part of the word finds the value faster while typing; a fixed short list stays the select's (Spec 014 ⑤ closes the alternative search-in-list).
Several values from one list are the plurelektilo's, because a select takes one; it shows the chosen as a count or as tags (Spec 025 ③ closes the alternative multiple).

boundary.kialo: A drawn list with icons and descriptions is the listelektilo, because it brings its own keyboard and screen reader behaviour (Spec 025 ③ closes the boundary custom-popup); a list of words stays the platform's.
Options under headings in one list are a choice of a person, because a heading is no option and the grouping changes what the list says; Fundamento has no such Ero yet.
A select without a visible label shows a prompt or an option without saying what is chosen, because the prompt is gone once an option is chosen.

containers.name: form
containers.kialo: A select without a form has no sender, because its value is only sent with the form.

containers.name: dialog
containers.kialo: A dialog may ask for one of many values before it ends, because the decision it ends in may need it (a country).

containers.name: filter-bar
containers.kialo: A filter of many values folds them into one field above the list it narrows — in the region fields of the filtrilo — because a row of every value would push the list away.

with.kialo: A select stands among the fields of a form, with the same height and the width of the container, because a person reads a form top down and fills it in that order.
The form ends with the button that sends it, because choosing an option does nothing by itself; the button stands after the last field.
The chevron at the end of the field is an ikono chevron-down, because the sign that a list opens below is vocabulary of the Ikonaro, drawn by the Aspekto in the size of the field.

never.kialo: A select stands in no slot of a button, because a button is one target with one name and the list could not be reached on its own.
